title: Pre-Phase-0 legacy results
summary: The 720 runs recorded before the Phase-0 evaluation-integrity work (6 models × 24 tasks × 5), kept read-only in reports/runs.sqlite. Shown as recorded, unranked, and never pooled with a Phase-0 release.
comparability: Historical results are not directly comparable with Modern Local v1. Eighteen of the 24 task definitions changed and the historical runs predate the current evaluation-integrity system.
not_recorded: model digests (only two short prefixes are documented in the README)
backend provenance per run (no backend_kind; runs are not linked to evaluation jobs)
a per-run generation configuration (settings are documented per group only)

caveats.label: Not comparable with Modern Local v1
caveats.summary: Historical results are not directly comparable with Modern Local v1. Eighteen of the 24 task definitions changed and the historical runs predate the current evaluation-integrity system.
points: These runs are unranked here: they are shown as recorded (pass counts, timeouts, voided runs and mean final scores under formula v0.1); no confidence intervals or ranks are computed for them.
Scores used scoring formula v0.1; 18 of the 24 tasks have since changed version (see the task table), so their old results do not describe the current tasks.
